title: Babysitting
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸晚上要出去玩。

lines.en: Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig are going to babysit.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶和猪爷爷要去照顾孩子了。

lines.en: Granny Pig! Grandpa Pig! Granny Igg! Papa Igg!
lines.zh: 猪奶奶！猪爷爷！哇哦！伊格爸爸！
哈喽，我的小宝贝们！你好！

lines.en: Peppa, George, into your beds, quick!
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，到你的床上去，快点！

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are leaving for their evening out.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸要出去玩了。

lines.en: Peppa and George are so good. They just fell asleep when Mummy Pig told them to.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治太好了。当猪妈妈叫他们睡的时候，他们就睡着了。

lines.en: I wonder if we should check upstairs.
lines.zh: 我想知道我们是否应该去楼上检查一下。
好吧，我从来没有。睡得很快。

lines.en: So, it wasn't Peppa and George making all that noise.
lines.zh: 所以，发出这些噪音的并不是佩奇和乔治。

lines.en: I think they really have fallen asleep.
Gardening. Today we are talking about roses.
lines.zh: 园艺。今天我们要说的是玫瑰。

lines.en: The kiff skate is a particularly thorny rose.
To prune it, start by lopping off the head and then snip away the budding shoots.
lines.zh: 要修剪它，首先要砍掉头部，然后剪掉萌芽的芽。

lines.en: Peppa? George? You should be in bed asleep.
lines.zh: 佩奇？乔治？你应该在床上睡觉。

lines.en: George and I aren't sleepy at all. Can we watch TV with you?
lines.zh: 乔治和我一点也不困。我们可以和你一起看电视吗？

lines.en: Well, I suppose watching a little TV might make you sleepy.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想看一点电视可能会让你昏昏欲睡。

lines.en: Icelandic roses are a rare treat for the discerning horticulturalist.
lines.zh: 冰岛玫瑰对于挑剔的园艺家来说是一种难得的享受。

lines.en: But they are prone to lobbing in severed habitats.
lines.zh: 但它们很容易在被切断的栖息地中投掷。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig, can you play that game where you throw us up and catch us?
lines.zh: 猪爷爷，你能玩那个把我们扔起来然后接住我们的游戏吗？

lines.en: Okay, but just one turn each.

lines.zh: 你看起来比以前更重了。

lines.en: Maybe Grandpa Pig is a bit tired.

lines.zh: 猪奶奶，我们来玩接球吧。

lines.en: You're it! Catch us if you can!
lines.zh: 就是你了！如果可以的话，请抓住我们！

lines.en: Lummy Pig and Daddy Pig are back home.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸回家了。

lines.en: I hope our little piggies are asleep.
lines.zh: 我希望我们的小猪都睡着了。

lines.en: The little piggies are asleep and so are the big piggies.
lines.zh: 小猪睡着了，大猪也睡了。
